title: Assembly graphs: the missing link between CAD data and the next generation of robots #AI #industry
description:
AI models are getting better at telling robots what to do, but on a car assembly line, the hard part is knowing which parts actually fit together.

At #CDL26, Christoph Jahn from Mercedes-Benz will explain why assembly graphs could be the missing link between CAD data and the next generation of robots. 

When labelled data is scarce, a bigger model doesn't solve the problem. Christoph shows how turning engineering knowledge into graph structure helps robots make precise decisions, and why a hybrid of AI models and graphs may be where physical AI is heading.

Session: What Do Robots Do Without Data? Why Assembly Graphs May Be the Missing Layer Between CAD and Vision-Language-Action Robots
 🎤 Christoph Jahn, Industry Assembly Planning, Mercedes-Benz AG
 📅 Thursday 12 November | 15:50-16:20 | Edges Track
 📍 Leonardo Royal Hotel London Tower Bridge
